description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'RenderedEntity' that handles rendering entities in specific view modes within the Drupal Views module. It manages dependencies, rendering logic, cache settings, and configuration options for displaying entities.

classes.name: Drupal\views\Plugin\views\field\RenderedEntity
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that renders an entity in a specified view mode within the Views module, managing rendering, dependencies, and cache settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RenderedEntity plugin with necessary services and configuration.

methods.name: usesGroupBy
methods.description: Indicates whether the field uses SQL GROUP BY clause; returns FALSE.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the plugin, including 'view_mode'.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the plugin, allowing selection of view mode.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entity in the specified view mode if accessible, returning a render array.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts; empty array indicating no specific contexts.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags; empty array as tags are bubbled up elsewhere.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age, set to permanent.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Provides custom query logic, integrating with entity translation renderer if multilingual.

methods.name: getEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Returns the entity type manager service.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies, especially related to view modes.
